analogy.rationale: WEE1 inhibition removes the G2/M checkpoint, causing premature mitotic entry and DNA damage accumulation, so CHK and CDK inhibitors that perturb the same checkpoint and cell-cycle machinery should give the most similar responses, with mitotic kinases (Aurora, PLK) and DNA synthesis inhibitors producing related downstream programs.
